title: Final Average Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the ensemble average energy U.

title: Final Average Energy Squared
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the ensemble average of the energy squared U^2.

title: Correct Use of Probabilities
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of how to apply probabilities for the energy values of the spins.

title: Correct Application of Averages
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for the average of sums and products of independent variables.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of averages.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for the energy values.
